title: Replication Package for: "Teralizer: Semantics-Based Test Generalization from Conventional Unit Tests to Property-Based Tests"
description: Replication package for Teralizer, a semantics-based approach to generalizing conventional unit tests into property-based tests. Source code (Java, Python, and scripts) is licensed under MIT. Data and documentation are licensed under CC BY 4.0. Analyzed projects retain their original licenses. Funding: FWF Austrian Science Fund grant 10.55776/P36698 (Semantic Change Impact Analysis) and Austrian Research Promotion Agency (FFG) grant 892418 (INTEGRATE).
